scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducible exact-rational diagnostics accompany this result. Finite computations are not proofs for all graph orders. Primary sources and distinct related graph-variation findings were compared; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Connected finite simple unweighted undirected graphs, real inputs, positive simplex mass and Euclidean nearest-point projection. Exact connectivity-stratified envelope only for n>=4q (and n=2,3 at q=1). No weighted-graph or non-Euclidean claim. Exact fixed-graph formula can be exponential. Historical novelty requires further independent assessment.
title: Sharp graph-variation instability of simplex projection under edge-connectivity constraints
